title: A push to a lane branch inside a running batch is refused
why: Plan R26 (batch freeze) and R55 (owner 13:21 CST Nov 12, merge flow first; home decision no-merge-during-batch-ci).
note: Split from step batch-freeze-lane-set-enforce so its built part can merge: main has the frozen set, blame-limited --batch-drop and --ready; the lane built the FREEZE_CITE swap and a settings entry for the three flags (commit 3e17eb534). Left: a guard that refuses a push to a lane branch inside a running batch. It must read the batch PR body at push time, and the cloud has no gh for that read, so the route is open (MCP read, or a record the merge tool writes at batch build). State its cost per push. Red first. Closed 13:41 CST Nov 12 (coordinator 13:37): covered by #2463 (step lane-push-frozen-in-batch); the only gap, draft batch PRs, runs no CI, so not built.
